summary: Unity Bancorp filed an 8-K solely to announce a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.16 per common share, payable June 18, 2026 to holders of record June 4, 2026. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary current report on a standard dividend declaration and contains no special-situation event. As such, it does not constitute a special situation.
